Umayyad Caliphate (661–750)
At its greatest extent, the Umayyad Caliphate covered 5.17 million square miles (13,400,000 km2), making it the largest Islamic empire in the world.

Extended from Asia, Africa and Europe.

This Islamic State was a superpower Empire both economically and in military around the world.

The media doesn’t talk about them nor do they tell in history classes just because so called modern superpower states don’t want their story compared to greater states in the past.
